lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately six identifiable horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct nodal points most visible in the posterior section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the upper margin and shadowing on the lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance spots is visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the anterior edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-contrast, elongated white features consistent with attached remoras are visible on the dorsal and lateral surfaces. A prominent, bright white linear feature trails from the dorsal midline posterior to the first dorsal fin.
